title: HEIAuthRisk: A Dataset of Successful Cloud Identity Authentication Events for Behavioral and Security Analysis
description: HEIAuthRisk is a pseudonymized dataset of 73,526 successful Google Workspace authentication events associated with 12,190 actor pseudonyms from two higher-education institutions. The public schema contains 23 attributes covering authentication context, observed history, recent login frequency, network and geographic novelty, and the provider-generated provider_suspicious operational signal. The signal is not forensic ground truth of account compromise. The public artifact includes the dataset, manifest, validation code, data dictionary, privacy/provenance documentation, and the Article 1 characterization notebook.

creators.name: Pena, Salomão Bento Nilo
creators.affiliation: Instituto Superior de Ciências da Educação da Huíla (ISCED-Huíla); Universidade Federal de Uberlândia (UFU)

notes: Only the public dataset is included. The restricted tier, raw institutional logs, credentials, and HMAC keys are not part of this public record. provider_suspicious is an operational provider signal, not forensic ground truth.
